quiz_title: Web Design Advanced - Quiz 2: Utilities & Responsive Grids

questions.q: What padding does the Bootstrap utility class 'p-3' represent?
questions.exp: Bootstrap spacing utilities scale from 1 (small) to 5 (large). p-3 provides nice medium spacing!

questions.q: The powerful Bootstrap grid system is based on how many columns in a row?
questions.exp: The grid system divides screens into exactly 12 imaginary columns! You partition sizes to equal 12.

questions.q: Which class makes columns take exactly half the row width on mobile phones?
questions.exp: col-6 targets extra small mobile screen sizes by default, spanning half of the 12-column layout!

questions.q: Which breakpoint class targets medium tablet screen sizes?
questions.exp: md- stands for medium screens (like tablets) starting from 768px wide!

questions.q: Which utility class curves element corners into a perfect circle in Bootstrap?
questions.exp: rounded-circle appliesborder-radius 50%, transforming cards or profile photos into elegant circles!
